cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: Before the open on 23 Sep (TipRanks stamp 08:29 ET) Beyond Meat disclosed a private exchange of about $15.0m of its 0% 2027 converts into common stock at 96% of face. That is 1,097,444 shares at closing plus up to 848,265 true-up shares, priced on a 3-trading-day VWAP beginning 23 Sep with a $7.4009 floor. On a post-split base of about 17.2m shares that is roughly 8-11% dilution. The stock fell 15.86% on 23 Sep and a further 9.07% by 15:04 ET on 24 Sep, almost all of it intraday (gap share 0.02), while the pricing window was running.

evidence.claim: The 8-K (items 3.02 and 8.01) says: $15.0m of 2027 notes exchanged at 96% of face; 1,097,444 shares at the initial settlement around 23 Sep; up to 848,265 true-up shares at the final settlement around 28 Sep; 3-trading-day VWAP beginning 23 Sep; floor $7.4009; Section 4(a)(2).
The wire copy was published at 12:29 UTC on 23 Sep, before the open, and put the market cap at $205m.
515.8m shares were outstanding at 5 Aug 2026, and a 1-for-30 reverse split took effect on 13 Aug 2026, which gives roughly 17.2m shares after the split.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The VWAP pricing period for the note exchange ends at the close on 2026-09-25, inside the window. The true-up shares (up to 848,265) settle around 2026-09-28, outside it.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K or release before the 25 Sep open. That could be an early close of the VWAP period or a final share count, which would end the selling a day early. It could also be a second exchange of the roughly $14.5m of 2027 notes still outstanding, which would restart the selling and make this more negative.

findings.finding: The share count for the $15m 2027-note exchange is set by a 3-trading-day VWAP that began on 23 Sep, so 25 Sep is the last pricing day. The exchanging holders, who took 1,097,444 shares on 23 Sep and are owed up to 848,265 more, keep selling or hedging into that session's VWAP, and this supply is exhausted only at the 25 Sep close.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The pricing period is dated in the 8-K: three trading days beginning 2026-09-23, so 23, 24 and 25 Sep. The last third of the holders' distribution trades inside the scored window, and the seller is finished only at the window's own closing print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: I found no earlier VWAP-priced exchange by this issuer; the October 2025 transaction was a registered exchange offer, not a VWAP deal. On second-day follow-throughs in this name's own record, the next session went +4.12% after 2026-04-24, -2.88% after 2026-05-08 and -2.59% after 2026-09-02, per the baseline history. The 69-event median is -2.38%.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has absorbed two of the three distribution days, but the third day's flow has not traded yet. At about $9.5 VWAP the deal comes to about 1.5m shares, roughly one day of normal volume (20-day median dollar volume about $11.5m, about 1.2m shares at today's price), so a third of it is still to go. If the price already held it, the stock would have stabilised on 24 Sep on normal volume; instead it made a new 52-week low (pos_52w 0.0) on 2.04x volume, falling 8.9% intraday with no gap.
findings.independence: A secondary note describes the same dilution (~8% more shares to retire ~5% of the debt): https://rallies.ai/news/beyond-meat-to-issue-1097444-shares-in-private-exchange-of-usd-15-million-2027-notes-6db952879ed17e90. The ATM is closed because the issuer is not S-3 eligible (10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655210/000165521026000055/bynd-20260627.htm), so this private exchange is the only supply channel open, and it is the one running.

outside_window.finding: The seller is finished at the 25 Sep close when the VWAP period ends. The usual post-pricing relief, with no more hedge sales, would show from the 2026-09-28 session, which is outside this window.
Up to 848,265 true-up shares are issued at the final settlement around 28 Sep; the exact count depends on the final VWAP.

About $14.5m of 0% 2027 notes remain after this exchange ($29.5m at 27 Jun less $15m). The 10 Aug supplemental indenture removed the 2030-note restriction on exchanging them, so a repeat private exchange with the same VWAP-selling pattern is possible, but no date exists.

In the Sonate trademark case the court on 18 Sep cut actual damages from $23.5m to $37,500 and left the $15.4m disgorgement in place, for a final judgment of $15,437,500. Further motions or appeals are possible, but none is dated.
The next earnings date, 2026-11-09, is only the Zacks cadence estimate and is not company-announced. It is a prior, not evidence.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with this name's own record (median -2.38, 33% up) and with its high 9.7% ATR. It sits against the moderate 2.04x volume, which is near the band where phase 0 averages a next-session rise, so the emitted -1.5 is kept equal to the single finding and not pushed toward the -2.38 history.
